mapper.sql: id, code, name, belong_employee_id, follow_employee_id, type, hand_level, country_region, company_website, company_address, company_name, remark, guanjiapo_code, guanjiapo_name, store_status, store_operation_time, store_operation_user, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted, order_default_remark
mapper.select: SELECT pyc.*, (select nick_name from sys_user where sys_user.user_id= pyc.belong_employee_id) as belongEmployeeName, (select nick_name from sys_user where sys_user.user_id= pyc.follow_employee_id) as followEmployeeName, (select region_name from sys_region where region_id = pyc.country_region) as countryRegionName, (select nick_name from sys_user where sys_user.user_id= pyc.store_operation_user) as storeOperationUserName, (select value from sys_dictionary where id = pyc.customer_source) as customerSourceValue, (select value from sys_dictionary where id = pyc.type) as typeValue FROM sal_yt_customer as pyc WHERE pyc.id = #{id} AND pyc.is_deleted = 0

SELECT pyc.*, (select nick_name from sys_user where sys_user.user_id= pyc.belong_employee_id) as belongEmployeeName, (select nick_name from sys_user where sys_user.user_id= pyc.follow_employee_id) as followEmployeeName, (select region_name from sys_region where region_id = pyc.country_region) as countryRegionName FROM sal_yt_customer as pyc WHERE pyc.is_deleted = 0 AND pyc.is_vip = 1
AND pyc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{vipCustomerName}, '%')
ORDER BY pyc.create_time DESC

SELECT pyc.*, (select nick_name from sys_user where sys_user.user_id= pyc.belong_employee_id) as belongEmployeeName, (select nick_name from sys_user where sys_user.user_id= pyc.follow_employee_id) as followEmployeeName, (select region_name from sys_region where region_id = pyc.country_region) as countryRegionName FROM sal_yt_customer as pyc WHERE pyc.is_deleted = 0 AND (pyc.is_vip = 0 OR pyc.is_vip IS NULL)
AND pyc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nonVipCustomerName}, '%')
ORDER BY pyc.create_time DESC
select a.`name` as name, b.create_time as createTime from sal_yt_customer a left join sal_sed_quotation b on a.id=b.customer_id where b.id=#{quotationId}
select * from sal_yt_customer where (follow_employee_id=#{followEmployeeId} or belong_employee_id= #{saleEmployeeId}) and is_deleted=0
